calibration.basis: weekly meter points (usage.meter_delta seven_day, no overrun added) over the dollars of the calls that delta spans (cost_estimate.metered_usd), summed over every run_eval invocation of the runs ingested before this one that measured both

invocations.basis: an estimate from the CLI's own per-call dollar figures (total_cost_usd, else modelUsage costUSD), times the measured points-per-dollar rate; not a meter reading

reasons.metered_usd: a call inside the measured meter span carried no dollar figure
